title: Optimize vector zero-limit search
description: Avoid HNSW lazy build/search work when VectorIndex::search is called with k = 0.
convergence_criteria: k == 0 returns empty after dimension validation; vector index tests pass
hints: Preserve missing-index and dimension-mismatch error behavior.
execution_directives: cargo fmt --check; cargo check --lib; cargo test --lib storage::vector_index -- --nocapture; cargo test --lib storage::fusion -- --nocapture
findings: Added a zero-limit fast path after dimension validation and a test proving it skips lazy build while still rejecting mismatched query dimensions.
